concerns.text: The dependency table states the manifest (T009) 'executes unconditionally' in the amendment-rejection path, yet T009 is ordered 'after T004–T008' and its specified content (descriptors, PC scores, exclusion flags, power_status) is produced exclusively by amendment-contingent tasks T003–T006. In the rejection path, T009 as written has no producers for most of its mandatory fields — either define the reduced rejection-path manifest as a distinct artifact or reorder/re-scope T009 so the unconditional claim is coherent.

T010–T012 carry unfilled '[P?]' parallel-safety tags. T010–T012 are inherently sequential (T011's report cites T010's performance record; T012 re-runs everything), so they should be tagged non-parallel explicitly rather than left ambiguous.

T010, T011, T012 are tagged [US1] but appear after the US2/US3 tasks (T004–T009), breaking user-story contiguity: the US1 block (T001–T003) is not independently shippable as grouped because its tagged members span all three phases. Either re-tag the Phase-3 tasks (e.g., a validation/reporting story) or note that US1's shippable unit ends at the Phase-1 checkpoint.
